reading.title: Childhood, Career Come Full Circle for Budget Analyst at NASA Goddard
reading.summary: Conversations about NASA were the norm around the dinner table during Ashley Knight’s childhood. Her parents worked at NASA’s Goddard Space Flight Center in Greenbelt, Maryland, and discussions about happenings at the agency continued even when they came home from the office. “I remember a poignant dialogue we had after the space shuttle Challenger disaster,” […]

news.title: Sales for Biden memoir fall far short of books by Obama and Clinton
news.summary: Promise Me, America, which has lukewarm reviews from critics, sold about 21,000 copies during its first week on sale Joe Biden’s memoir Promise Me, America debuted with modest sales and lackluster reviews, selling about 21,000 copies during its first week on sale, according to Circana. It sold well enough to top the New York Times nonfiction bestseller list, but didn’t approach the level of memoirs by such predecessors as Barack Obama and Bill Clinton. Continue reading...
